name: Harley-Davidson Street 750
engine: 749 cc liquid-cooled Revolution X V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Harley's small liquid-cooled twin. Many were in a brake caliper corrosion recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2016-2019 Street 500 and 750 bikes are in recall 18V927 because salt corrosion in the brake calipers can make the brakes drag.
A-002.reason: Dragging brakes can affect stability. Dealers fit new calipers free.

recalls.what: Brake caliper piston bore corrosion can make the brakes drag.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits new front and rear calipers free (Harley recall 0174).
